experiences.title: The Hidden Kingdom

experiences.description:
## Highlights
- Guided herping night walk
- Basics of wildlife photography
- Stargazing with a telescope
- Camping, midnight Maggi and chai
- Hidden waterfall in the morning

## Meet the guides
Nigel Anchan is a wildlife conservationist, macro photographer and herper who has documented reptiles and amphibians across India's biodiversity hotspots. Daimler Pereira is a naturalist, wildlife photographer and herping specialist known for his work in the Western Ghats. Every encounter is safe, ethical and respectful of the animals.

## What's included
- Guided herping night walk
- Overnight tent camping
- Traditional Maharashtrian dinner
- Midnight Maggi and chai
- Village breakfast
- HD photos and videos
- Waterfall experience
- First aid certified leader
- All permits and entry fees

## What to bring
- Full-length pants and full-sleeve clothing
- Closed shoes
- Headlamp or torch
- Rain jacket
- Reusable water bottle (compulsory)
- Personal medication
experiences.itinerary:
## Day 1
6:00 pm | Arrive at base camp, meet your guides, welcome drink
7:00 pm | Traditional Maharashtrian dinner
After dark | The Hidden Kingdom night walk: snakes, frogs, geckos, spiders and more
1:00 am | Return to base camp
1:30 am | Midnight Maggi and chai, sleep in tents
## Day 2
10:00 am | Village breakfast
10:30 am | Hidden waterfall experience
experiences.faqs:
Is it safe?
Yes. Your guides are experienced herpers and First Aid certified. We keep a safe distance and never handle animals.

Will we definitely see snakes?
Sightings are never guaranteed, but we regularly see frogs, geckos, spiders, insects, scorpions and reptiles.

Is there a plastic rule?
Yes. Zero plastic and glass. A reusable bottle is compulsory and any plastic you bring goes back with you.

Need transport?
₹500 per person from Asangaon station. Arrive by 5:00 pm.

reviews.name: Divyam Sanghvi
reviews.text: Superb experience, right from answering our queries, teaching valuable lessons on astronomy, safe hiking, to taking utmost care of each and every aspect at the location, everything was perfect. Thanks for an awesome weekend and helping us spot fireflies. Definitely recommend

reviews.name: Krishna Vijayvargiya
reviews.text:
Such an enthralling experience it was! Camping, trekking, bonfire, waterfalls, staying in a village, all part of their package. They customise as per your needs. And the best part is they take smaller groups only, so that you can spend time and bond and be yourself rather than always being in rush!! 🤍

I'm planning another trip real soon with them 🤗

reviews.name: Shruti Vaghela
reviews.text: Recently went for their **stargazing** trip for the Geminids meteor shower. What a wonderful little getaway with the most warm and welcoming people! Super comfortable set up with all the amenities you could need! Rock & Anchor has also taken the initiative to involve local villagers, providing well paying employment opportunities - an underrated perk of which you get to enjoy first hand, the DELICIOUS food they make for you, from locally grown ingredients! Would undoubtedly visit again and recommend to others. Worth the money for sure! :)

reviews.name: Jinesh Shah
reviews.text: They are a class apart. Prepare to get excited about India’s outdoors in a unique way. They pick Great destinations, they choose the most sustainable options. The folks running Rock & Anchor are nature lovers, experienced at leading outdoors & rescue, & are wonderful humans. If you’re tired of going to restaurants, clubs & shopping malls, look no further. Give them a call.

reviews.name: Mradul Dubey
reviews.text: If you're looking for something offbeat and exciting to do over a weekend near Mumbai, Rock and Anchor's **stargazing** experience is something that you shouldn't miss! From informative sessions to experiencing a glimpse of a sustainable and environmentally friendly way of living, there is so much to learn and know about. Would highly recommend this overall truly enriching experience.

reviews.name: Abhilasha Khaitan
reviews.text: Incredible experience led by Aadi. We were two beginners and he made us feel safe and confident. That apart, his respect for nature and the support for the locals was remarkable. Sign up with Rock and Anchor if you want an authentic, exciting experience. I’ll definitely be a regular with them.

team.name: Aaditya Shah

team.name: Mansi Nayyar

team.name: Prasad
